Cell x IZ firing matrix from track centres

Source: R/izone_adjacency.R
build_firing_matrix.Rd

An IZ is fired in a cell when the centre of one of the cell's IZ-assigned tracks (optionally only tracks shorter than max_track_width_bp) falls inside it.

Usage

build_firing_matrix(izones, tracks, meta_data, max_track_width_bp = NULL)

Arguments

izones

GRanges of IZs with an iz_id column (e.g. make_adjacent_pairs()$izones).

tracks

Named GRangesList of tracks with columns cell_id (matching the names), rep_percent and iz_id.

meta_data

A data.frame with columns cell_id (unique) and rep_percent; missing values are taken from the tracks.

max_track_width_bp

NULL or the exclusive maximum track width.

Value

A list with fired (sparse 0/1 dgCMatrix, cells x IZs) and cell_info (cell_id, rep_percent, n_tracks, n_retained_tracks, n_fired_izones, n_tracks_hitting_iz).
